name: Maid to Houshi to Goshujin-sama
original_name: メイドと奉仕とご主人様
source:
"A week ago, my step mother introduced a man to me, saying that I would be serving him as a maid.
She's been a high spender, and my family had to pay the price for her debt.
And it was my turn...
I was very tired of the life and accepted it.
And from that moment, I have become my master's sex doll...."

This is a simulation game about a maid who is sold to a rich man as a sex doll.
You become the heroine and offer various kinds of service to your master.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065218.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“一周前，我的继母给我介绍了一个男人，说我要给他当女仆。
她花钱大手大脚，我的家人不得不为她的债务付出代价。
轮到我了…
我厌倦了这种生活并接受了它。
从那一刻起，我就成了我主人的性玩偶……”

这是一款关于女仆被作为性玩偶卖给有钱人的模拟游戏。
你成为女主角，为你的主人提供各种服务。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065218.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
